output.sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int AS order_year,
         SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue
  FROM marts.fct_orders
  WHERE is_revenue
    AND order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
         (MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN revenue END)
          - MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue END))
         / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue END), 0) * 100
       , 2) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM yearly;
output.explanation: Revenue is defined as orders with is_revenue = true, measured by net_revenue. The query sums net_revenue per calendar year (2024 and 2025) from marts.fct_orders, then computes the percentage growth from 2024 to 2025 as (2025 − 2024) / 2024 × 100, rounded to 2 decimals. NULLIF guards against a zero 2024 base.
